messages:
Maria: quick async - shipped kernel slot-fairness patch yesterday, reduced slot contention in the hot loop (~12% on local microbench). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4234
AJ: nice. i skimmed the diff, left a couple comments about the lock ordering on shard_alloc. can you add a small unit test for the race?
Maria: yep will add a test. reproducible command: `./bench.sh --model small --seq 512 --clients 64 --mode microburst`
Maria: failing e2e on multi-turn cache init in staging, see snippet below:
```
2026-03-17T22:01:12Z runtime ERROR kv_init: shard 4 failed to alloc: out_of_memory
2026-03-17T22:01:12Z runtime WARN falling back to cold-path for prefix cache
```
Sam K: I can take the e2e tonight. sounds like a race during shard bootstrap. curious if initial_shards is too low under the microburst profile. try `KV_INITIAL_SHARDS=8` as a quick smoke.
Ryan: for today i'll finish the batching heuristic tweak (slot coalescing + max_wait clamp) and run across the usual model set. will post p95/p99 once done. @Maria do you want me to include the kernel patch in the canary matrix?
Maria: please include it in canary-3. want to confirm no regressions with our prefix caching.
deploy-bot: started canary rollout commit abc123 -> pool canary-3 (3 machines)
AJ: quick note on the batching tweak: if we lower max_wait below 6ms we see tail pops for seq>1024. recommend testing 6/8/12ms.
Ryan: ran quick microbench on canary-3 with kernel patch + batching tweak (single-run):
- model: redwood-small, seq:512, clients:64
- baseline p95: 48.3ms -> patched p95: 41.7ms
- throughput: +7% (tokens/s)
Maria: nice! also saw KV warmup improvement locally: cold-miss rate ~30% -> 21% after prefix caching change.
Sam K: i'll run the full e2e with `KV_INITIAL_SHARDS=8` and the patch merged to feature branch, report back before EOD.
Maria: blockers: need the unit test from AJ and confirmation from Sam that e2e passes on canary. otherwise today: add test, merge small followups, coordinate rollback plan if canary shows regression.
AJ: i can push a small unit test PR in the next hour.
Ryan: if canary looks good i'll trigger a limited rollout to dedicated-pool-2 tomorrow morning.
Maria: thanks all. ping here when e2e finishes or if you see any OOM spikes in staging. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: canary canary-3 health: 3/3 healthy (10m checks)
Sam K: e2e finished on feature branch with KV_INITIAL_SHARDS=8, no OOMs in 30m soak. posting logs in gist in a sec.
Maria: great — please paste link when ready and i'll cut the follow-up merge.
